sentences.text:
THIS APPEAL COMING ON FOR HEARING, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT

The present appeal is filed by the appellant/claimant challenging the judgment and award dated 03.12.2011 in MVC.No.1973/2008 passed by the Prl. Civil Judge (Sr.Dn.) & MACT, Srirangapatna,
for seeking enhancement of compensation.
2. The factum of accident is not in dispute.

3. Heard the arguments from both sides and perused the records.
4.

The Tribunal has awarded compensation under various heads as follows:
NC: 2023:KHC:21209 Pain and suffering 30,000.00
Loss of future income 59,400.00
Medical expenses 15,500.00 Incidental expenses 10,000.00 Loss of amenities
Loss of income during treatment 3,000.00
Future medical expenses 5,000.00
From the medical evidence on record, the claimant has suffered the fracture of left tibia bone and finds difficulty in walking.
The doctor has stated that the claimant has suffered 30% of disability towards left lower limb and 15% of disability towards whole body.
The claimant is working as an agriculturist, therefore, certainly the above injuries affects the agricultural work.
6. Therefore, considering the nature of injuries sustained by the claimant, it is just and proper to award additional global compensation of Rs.50,000/-.

Accordingly, the appellant/claimant is Venkatesha vs Ajaysharma on 19 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/112792574/
2 entitled to additional NC: 2023:KHC:21209 global compensation of Rs.50,000/- along with interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of petition till realization, in addition to what has been awarded by the Tribunal.
Accordingly, I proceed to pass the following ORDER i.
The appeal is allowed-in-part.

ii. The impugned judgment and award dated 03.12.2011 in MVC.No.1973/2008 passed by the Prl. Civil Judge (Sr.Dn.) & MACT, Srirangapatna, is hereby modified to the extent that the appellant/claimant is entitled to additional global compensation of Rs.50,000/- along with interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of petition till realization, in addition to what has been awarded by the Tribunal.
iii. No order as to costs.
Registry is directed to transmit the TCR along with copy of this order to the Tribunal forthwith.
v. The entire amount shall be released in favour of the appellant/claimant.

vi. Draw award accordingly.
Sd/-
